name: Time field
description: A time typed one part at a time, with arrow keys to step each part, on a 12- or 24-hour clock.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the field. Replaced by the error while the field is invalid.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the field while it is invalid, with an alert icon.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: 12-hour clock with a day period, or 24-hour. Defaults to the locale's.

props.name: value
props.description: The time (controlled), for example new Time(9, 0). Use defaultValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: size
props.description: Field height of 32, 36 or 44 pixels, matching Input.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Requires a time before a form submits.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Shows the camellia outline and the error message.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the field and dims it to 50%.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components TimeField.
